title: Anthropic will mark all texts and images generated by Claude with an invisible watermark
summary: The company is implementing an imperceptible marking that can persist after basic edits to identify content produced by its AI.

title: Nvidia mobilizes $500 billion from Wall Street to finance AI infrastructure
summary: The manufacturer is allying with major financial institutions and backs the value of its own chips to channel capital toward GPUs, CPUs, and data centers.

title: Nvidia launches Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, its open and free AI model
summary: The new reasoning model prioritizes speed over maximum intelligence amid intense competition in the sector.

title: Researchers extract and reveal the hidden reasoning of proprietary AI models
summary: New attacks reconstruct the internal thought chains of APIs such as ChatGPT and expose clues and leaked data.

title: OpenAI completes another $7 billion offering for its employees to sell shares
summary: The company expands worker liquidity amid a revaluation of its shares.

title: OpenAI launches GPT-5.6-Cyber, an AI model for cybersecurity with reduced safeguards
summary: The new tool aims to respond to the rise of AI-driven attacks and is oriented toward exploit development.

title: GeForce RTX 50 cards cost up to 135% more than their reference price in the US
summary: Shortages and demand raise the average prices of graphics cards, with the RTX 5070 near $900.

title: Microsoft raises the price of Windows OEM licenses by 7% to 10%
summary: The increase affects manufacturers and could be passed on to the final price of new devices.

title: A modder attaches a Radeon RX 9070 XT to a Steam Machine using an M.2 to OCuLink adapter
summary: The modification allows demanding games to run at over 100 FPS with an external GPU.

title: Modified GeForce RTX 4080 cards with 32 GB flood the Chinese second-hand market
summary: GPUs altered with more memory circulate massively despite potential risks for buyers.

title: A modder turns a Steam Deck into a modern Game Boy called SteamBoy
summary: The project recreates the aesthetic of Nintendo's classic console while keeping Valve's hardware.

title: Intel mobilizes nearly $20 billion to expand its factories against TSMC
summary: The financing, with $100 billion in demand, will support capacity expansion and progress toward the 14A process.

title: Air traffic controller recruitment campaign among gamers reaches 94% of its goals in the US
summary: The program leverages players' skills and achieves record hires with salaries up to $155,000.

title: FBI and researchers uncover infiltration of North Korean IT workers into US companies and agencies
summary: The investigations reveal that remote employees with fake identities gained access to Western organizations to finance the regime's programs.
